name: fde-delivery-toolbox
description: Small, evidence-driven FDE workflows: discovery, preflight, delivery, evaluation and safe handoff. No production executor.

interface.shortDescription: Turn scoped workflows into verifiable delivery.
interface.longDescription: Run bounded discovery, access preflight, delivery, evaluation, and evidence-based handoff without adding production authority.
defaultPrompt: Assess this workflow and freeze one evidence-backed FDE task.
Preflight the systems, data, permissions, and failure boundaries for this task.
Evaluate this artifact against frozen acceptance and production-readiness gates.
